displayTitle: The Clone Wars: The Official Collector's Edition
synopsis: An in-depth special edition covering all 7 seasons of the fan-favorite, award-winning animated program.The magazine features behind-the-scenes interviews, character profiles, a detailed episode guide, and synopses for all the episodes, all lavishly illustrated with imagery from the Lucasfilm Image Archives and final frames.
title: The Clone Wars: The Official Collector's Edition
